title: GCM encrypt: authTagSz > CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN silently skips GET_TAG
description: Trigger: caller reaches crypto2dev_cipher for GCM encrypt with info->cipher.aesgcm_enc.authTagSz > 16 (e.g., via direct CryptoCb call bypassing wc_AesGcmEncrypt). Path: GET_TAG block condition is 'authTag \!= NULL && authTagSz > 0 && authTagSz <= CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN' — authTagSz > 16 fails the last check, entire GET_TAG is skipped. Return value: 0 (success). Bad outcome: authTag buffer holds stale data from before the call; caller propagates wrong auth tag without any error signal. Inconsistency: decrypt path returns BUFFER_E for authTagSz > TAG_MAXLEN; encrypt path silently succeeds. Fix: change encrypt condition to return BUFFER_E (matching decrypt) when authTagSz > CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN.
